subject.title: feat: add portable table presentation blocks

question: Should OpenClaw commit to `table` as a permanent public portable presentation block with the proposed caption, headers, rows, numeric-cell, and fallback semantics?
rationale: The PR adds a public Plugin SDK union member and exports that external plugins and agents may rely on; automated validation cannot decide the long-term API shape.

options.title: Accept the proposed table contract
options.body: Adopt the typed table block as the canonical portable row-and-column presentation API after live Slack proof and exact-head validation.

options.title: Narrow or revise the contract
options.body: Hold merge while maintainers change required fields, supported cell types, accessibility semantics, or channel ownership before external adoption.

options.title: Keep tables channel-private
options.body: Do not expand the portable SDK and continue using Slack-native blocks or text until a broader reporting abstraction is approved.

recommendation.title: Accept the proposed table contract
recommendation.body: Adopt the typed table block as the canonical portable row-and-column presentation API after live Slack proof and exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent merged history for the portable presentation contract and affected delivery paths.
